caption: A vibrant, spicy ramen broth glows beneath a generous mound of shredded cabbage and chopped green onions. Served in a white ceramic bowl, the dish rests on a dark wooden table under warm, ambient lighting.

segments_info.text: Dark wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and subtle reflections near the glass.
The spicy broth is vibrant red, glossy, and contains visible noodles and green vegetables beneath the toppings.
White ceramic bowl with smooth, glossy surface, subtle red pattern near rim, and faint specks visible.
A white ceramic spoon with smooth, glossy surface and slightly curved bowl shape.
